themes.title: Ownership
themes.question: What does it mean to own?
themes.description: We create, exchange, use and depend on things every day. But where does access end and ownership begin? Who decides what belongs to us, and what happens when the rules change?

themes.title: Permanence
themes.question: What deserves to last?
themes.description: Objects, memories, platforms and ideas. What do we choose to preserve? What should be repairable? And why are so many things designed to disappear?

themes.title: Energy
themes.question: What makes things possible?
themes.description: Energy powers everything we make, from the physical world to the digital one. Who has access to it? How is it distributed? What becomes possible when we rethink abundance?

themes.title: Peers
themes.question: What can we do together?
themes.description: We have more ways to connect than ever. Yet many of us feel increasingly disconnected. How do people organize, exchange and support one another? What becomes possible when we build together?
